title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential streets and corridors within walking distance of Cedarville University, featuring local student favorites and village landmarks.

cards.entity_name: Mom and Dad's Dairy Bar & Grill
cards.title: Dairy Bar on North Main
cards.subtitle: North Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this classic grill right across from campus for affordable soft-serve ice cream and burgers, a staple for student study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A popular ice cream and grill spot located directly across from the university entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Mom and Dad's Dairy Bar and Grill is located right across from campus and serves ice cream and grilled items.
cards.source_title: Cedarville's Local Eateries & Attractions - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Open seasonally for walk-up service; check local hours for evening availability.

cards.title: Coffee Corner on Main
cards.subtitle: North Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Study or relax at this historical coffee shop known for its cozy atmosphere and local roasts, situated in the heart of the village.
cards.short_summary: A central village coffee shop and popular student gathering place for studying and socializing.
cards.evidence_claim: Beans-n-Cream is a coffee shop in downtown Cedarville described as a favorite place to study or escape campus busyness.
cards.source_title: Make Your Cedarville Bucket List! - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Typically closes by 5 PM; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: Mexican Dining on South Main
cards.subtitle: South Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Head south of the main intersection for authentic Mexican dishes and their signature fried ice cream in a sit-down setting.
cards.short_summary: A local Mexican restaurant located just south of the village's central intersection.
cards.evidence_claim: Lola's Mexican Restaurant is located on South Main Street and is recommended for its Mexican dishes and fried ice cream.
cards.source_title: Make Your Cedarville Bucket List! - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; offers a budget-friendly lunch menu.

cards.title: Cookie Shop on Main
cards.subtitle: North Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Stop by this local bakery for fresh-baked treats that students often prefer over national chains; located near the village center.
cards.short_summary: A boutique cookie shop in downtown Cedarville popular for student care packages and snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Church Street Cookies is a local business in Cedarville noted as a must-try spot for students.
cards.source_title: 5 Things to do in Cedarville Without a Car - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Check social media for daily cookie flavors and updated operating hours.

cards.title: Classic Pizza on North Main
cards.subtitle: North Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Enjoy a Cedarville classic serving the community since 1981 with pizza, subs, and their famous breadsticks.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing local pizzeria and sub shop located in the downtown commercial block.
cards.evidence_claim: Colonial Pizza has been serving the Cedarville community since 1981 with pizza, subs, and breadsticks.
cards.source_title: Cedarville's Local Eateries & Attractions - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Open for dine-in and carry-out; a popular choice for group student dinners.

cards.title: Essential Supplies on North Main
cards.subtitle: North Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk to this convenient retail stop for dorm essentials, snacks, and household items without needing a car.
cards.short_summary: A primary retail destination for students to purchase groceries and household supplies near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Dollar General is listed as a place to visit for shopping in the Village of Cedarville.
cards.source_title: Make Your Cedarville Bucket List! - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Located on the northern end of the main commercial strip, easily accessible by foot from campus.

cards.title: Gourmet Coffee on Main
cards.subtitle: North Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Take advantage of the 10% student discount on Tuesdays at this upscale coffee and tea roaster in the village.
cards.short_summary: A gourmet coffee and tea shop offering student discounts and a quiet environment for study.
cards.evidence_claim: Orion Coffee and Tea offers a 10% discount with student ID on Tuesdays.
cards.source_title: Make Your Cedarville Bucket List! - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check for specific holiday or summer hours.

cards.title: Auto Care on West Xenia
cards.subtitle: West Xenia Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Access reliable automotive repairs and services at this local shop located just west of the main village intersection.
cards.short_summary: A local automotive repair shop providing essential services to the student and village community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Garage of Cedarville is located at 105 West Xenia Ave and provides automotive services.
cards.access_notes: Standard business hours; appointments recommended for student vehicle service.

cards.title: Bike Trail Crossing
cards.subtitle: Main Street & Trail Corridor
cards.notes: Hop on the paved Prairie Grass Trail for a scenic ride or walk; it intersects Main Street near the village center.
cards.short_summary: A major multi-use paved trail passing through the heart of Cedarville, connecting to Xenia and beyond.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ohio to Erie Trail (Prairie Grass Trail) passes through Cedarville and intersects at Main Street.
cards.source_title: Ohio to Erie Trail | Miami Valley Bike Trails
cards.access_notes: Paved and accessible year-round for walking, running, and cycling.

cards.title: Quick Eats on East Chillicothe
cards.subtitle: East Chillicothe Street Corridor
cards.notes: Find familiar sandwich options at this franchise located just off the main North Main Street thoroughfare.
cards.short_summary: A convenient fast-food sandwich shop located on the East Chillicothe Street block near downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway is located at 13 E. Chillicothe St. in Cedarville.
cards.access_notes: Located one block east of the main intersection; standard franchise hours.
